meta.title: Exploring Marble Mountains Da Nang Vietnam | Full Tour
meta.description:
Explore the stunning Marble Mountains in Da Nang, Vietnam, one of the most famous and spiritual attractions in central Vietnam. In this video, I take you through ancient caves, beautiful Buddhist pagodas, scenic viewpoints, and hidden paths inside the Marble Mountains.

Located just a few kilometers from Da Nang city, Marble Mountains are known for their limestone peaks, marble caves, sacred temples, and panoramic views of the coastline. This video will help you understand what to see, how to reach, best time to visit, entry fee, and travel tips before you plan your trip.

Whether you’re a first-time traveler to Vietnam or exploring Da Nang tourist places, Marble Mountains is a must-visit destination.

📍 Location: Da Nang, Vietnam
🕍 Highlights: Huyen Khong Cave, Linh Ung Pagoda, viewpoints
⏰ Best time to visit: Morning or late afternoon
